description: Designing in the background: picks an approved reference, writes slot copy from the post, places the creator's real photo and official app logos, proofreads, and leaves a draft for review. Memes: pass template "meme" and/or a meme library reference_id (bamf.list_design_references, category meme_template) to make a meme with Claude: only the template picture with the post's captions in its slots, no headline, footer, logo or CTA; needs post_id. Poll bamf.get_design. Never schedules or publishes. Costs credits.

instruction.description: Optional direction for a meme design (e.g. which point the captions make).

post_id.description: Post to design. Provide post_id or source_post_id.

qa.description: Mark as a QA run so the draft stays out of the review queue.

reference_id.description: Approved design reference to match, or a meme library template id (meme designs only).

name: bamf.design_post
